name: candor-finance
description: Candor is a personal finance app that helps you reach your money goals with ChatGPT. Your agent works from your real bank, card, loan, and investment accounts: it sets up goals and a budget with you, finds money you are losing to fees, price increases, or missed refunds, and remembers your plan and decisions between conversations. Every week Candor reviews your spending, bills, debt, savings, and investments and tells your agent what's worth talking through and why. Candor never moves money.

interface.longDescription:
Tell ChatGPT what you want with your money, like paying off the cards, buying a home, or working four days a week, even if you haven't worked it out yet. With Candor, ChatGPT works from your real bank, card, loan, and investment accounts and sets up the plan with you: goals with a target, a date, and a monthly amount, a budget that pays for them, and every charge in the right category.

Then it keeps you on it. Every week Candor reviews your spending, bills, debt, savings, and investments, finds what's worth talking through, and tells ChatGPT why, like a goal slipping, a bill that went up, a refund that never arrived, or cash earning too little.

Ask where your money goes each month, whether you can afford a move, or what changed since last week. ChatGPT can show cash flow, spending, budget, and goal charts in the conversation, keep transactions in the right categories, catch duplicate charges and price increases, and remember what to check on and when.

Every figure is computed from your records. Your goals, budget, decisions, and the reasons behind them stay saved in Candor across conversations, and you can see each change ChatGPT made and why. Your data is not sold or used to train models.

Requires a Candor account. You connect US bank, card, loan, and investment accounts on Candor's website, and access to them is read-only. Candor does not transfer money or execute trades.
defaultPrompt: Help me pay off my credit cards.
Where does my money go each month?
What should I know about my money this week?

publication.release_notes: Candor now sets up your money goals and a budget from your real accounts, and every week tells ChatGPT what's worth talking through. ChatGPT can now help you get started, plan a goal, set a budget, check in each week, run a full checkup, sort transactions, find money you're losing, get ready for taxes, and add records your bank doesn't send. Charts update live in the conversation.
